# Every line below MUST be reported as credential_assignment by _ss_scan_content.
# Lines carry the inline pragma so the gate does not flag this fixture itself;
# _ss_scan_content does not honour the pragma (the caller does), so the pragma
# is inert here and each line is still matched on its own merits.
#
# '#' comment lines and blank lines are skipped by the corpus sweep.

# ── unquoted forms — the detection gap #1755 exists to close ─────────────────
api_key=aabbccddeeff112233  # secret-scan:allow
export secret=aabbccddeeff112233  # secret-scan:allow
token: aabbccddeeff112233  # secret-scan:allow
API_KEY=sk-abcdefghijklmnop  # secret-scan:allow
password=hunter2hunter2  # secret-scan:allow
passwd=aabbccddeeff112233  # secret-scan:allow
api-key: ghp_1234567890abcdefghij  # secret-scan:allow

# ── quoted forms — must keep matching; the change is strictly additive ───────
api_key = "sk-abcdefghijklmnop"  # secret-scan:allow
secret='aabbccddeeff112233'  # secret-scan:allow
token: "ghp_1234567890abcdefghij"  # secret-scan:allow
export API_KEY="aabbccddeeff112233"  # secret-scan:allow

# ── values containing characters real credentials do use ────────────────────
api_key=abc+def/ghi=jklmnop  # secret-scan:allow
token: a.b-c_d1234567890  # secret-scan:allow
